2024_173_troy_ruth_c_wass_elementary_sch.paragraph: Stafford Smith, Inc. quote dated 06/10/2024 for the Troy - Ruth C. Wass Elementary School Bid Pack, covering cafeteria serving-line equipment for the school at 2340 Willard Dr, Troy, MI 48085, and carried on the Troy School District Board of Education agenda of June 20, 2024. Sales contact Matthew Bigelow of Stafford Smith's Madison Heights office priced six numbered items plus two stationary sneeze guards: Duke Manufacturing AeroServ hot food, utility, flush-mount cold pan and cashier units, Premier Metal & Glass food shields, and a Shaw PPC decor package built around a "Wass Wolves Way" mascot graphic. Merchandise is quoted at $45,267.00, installation at $4,500.00 and freight at $4,000.00, for a Project Grand Total of $53,767.00.

Commercial terms
Upon receipt of a business account application, signed quote or purchase order and credit department review, down payment and terms are established. Stafford-Smith reserves the right to progress bill for equipment, including items shipped by the manufacturer to Stafford-Smith for storage, not conditional on installation or operation. Stafford-Smith retains a security interest in all equipment, parts, small wares, accessories, attachments and additions until all amounts are paid, may file a financing statement, and retains an interest in proceeds if the buyer disposes of collateral in violation of the agreement.
